build.beforeDevCommand: python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.copytree('syncmaster', 'src-tauri/webapp', ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'), dirs_exist_ok=True)" && python3 syncmaster/server.py

security.csp: default-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* data: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* https:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:*

bundle.longDescription: Cross-platform UI for managing Hermes configuration sync over SSH+rsync.
